mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly GDPC1 (demand) signals robust economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expansionary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly UNRATE below 5.0% signals strengthening labor market conditions, fostering consumer confidence and corporate investment, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative despite UNRATE crossing below 5.0%, or the threshold isn't met.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increase in federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL index signals inflationary pressures and tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If returns are positive despite the combination, or the trigger isn't met.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising quarterly GDPC1 (demand) accelerates corporate investment and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 doesn't rise sufficiently in the regime or returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in monthly INDPRO below 117.8 signals unexpected contraction in production capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If returns are positive despite the drop, or the threshold isn't met.

mechanism_narrative: Steady increase in monthly PAYEMS (labor force) indicates robust employment growth, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If returns are negative despite rising employment, or the trend isn't sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Concomitant rise in FEDFUNDS and HOUST signals aggressive monetary tightening coupled with strong demand, creating market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If returns are positive despite the combination, or the trigger isn't met.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, rising INDPRO (supply) accelerates economic normalization, fostering investor confidence and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO doesn't rise sufficiently in the regime or returns are negative.
